name: mcl_mobitems_saddle.png
creative_prompt:
Create a standalone inventory item representing saddle for a grounded dark-fantasy survival world.

Do not reproduce or imitate the original Minecraft or Mineclonia sprite. Invent a fresh interpretation.

Design a heavily used riding saddle with thick aged leather, compressed seat wear, stitching, straps, buckles, a practical internal frame and dirt from repeated travel. Functional, repaired and weathered rather than ornate.

You have broad creative freedom over exact shape, proportions, construction and surface detail as long as the object remains the intended item.

Art direction: grounded dark-fantasy material realism; ancient, tactile, muted, weathered and physically believable. Restrained saturation, soft diffuse illumination and controlled micro-detail. Avoid glossy mobile-game icon styling, cartoon rendering, enlarged pixel art and unnecessary magical decoration.

Show exactly one complete isolated item with comfortable empty space around it.

Output only the item on REAL TRANSPARENCY (alpha = 0). Do not draw a checkerboard, transparency grid, background, environment, pedestal, text, border, UI or cast shadow. Everything outside the item must be fully transparent.
correction_prompt:
IMAGE A = original Mineclonia item.
IMAGE B = new creative design.

Keep Image B's design, materials and details.

Recompose Image B to match Image A's position on the canvas, occupied area and scale, orientation and viewing angle, and approximate silhouette footprint.

Image A controls composition and pose. Image B controls the actual design.

Do not copy Image A's surface design or pixel details.

Output only the isolated item on REAL TRANSPARENCY (alpha = 0). Do not draw a checkerboard, transparency grid, background, shadow, or any background pixels. Everything outside the item must be fully transparent.
